app.title: Resilience Architect: AWS DR Strategy Mapper
context.heading: Disaster Recovery as a Business Tradeoff
context.intro: Every organization faces a fundamental tradeoff: how much are you willing to invest in infrastructure redundancy versus how much downtime and data loss can your business tolerate?
context.body: This tool maps your workloads to AWS Disaster Recovery strategies based on your Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) targets, aligned with business criticality. The result is a clear, executive-ready view of your DR posture.
ingestion.heading: Add Your Workloads
ingestion.intro: Define each workload with its criticality tier and recovery targets. Add as many workloads as needed.
ingestion.name: Workload Name
ingestion.error.minimum: Please add at least one workload before proceeding.

dashboard.pieChartLabel: Pie chart showing workload distribution across DR strategies
dashboard.quadrantChartLabel: Scatter chart plotting workloads by cost and criticality

strategy.br.con1: Highest potential data loss (hours to days)
strategy.pl.pro1: Cost-effective with core services always running
strategy.pl.con1: Compute resources scaled down, require spin-up
strategy.pl.con2: Moderate RTO (tens of minutes to hours)
strategy.ws.con2: Scaled-down environment may need scaling on failover
strategy.ms.pro2: No failover delay — traffic routes automatically
strategy.ms.con2: Complex licensing, data replication, and operational overhead
